metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a close shave, a chair, forty lines taken, three books signed, and Egeon at two.

yesterday: The beard is close enough for a stage beard to sit over.
The Nurse stands. Forty lines are out of the fourth act, and the cut is better, which annoyed you.
Two cloaks are out, Prince and Paris, back on Innocents' night, counted. Nick held under the note. Nine of the clock, after supper, bow to the chair.
The Rose played Harry the Fifth. You stayed, and at two you were Egeon.
